title: 第4章 战争临近
content_zh:
时间一晃就两个月过去了，雷豪每天早上起床点卯，操练一上午，中午带着小队出去巡山.他打熬身体和力量，手下的小妖巡山，傍晚再操练手下的小妖，这种生活简单而充实。

原来他雷豪没了电脑，没了手机，没了平板也可以活得这么充实的。

每天感受力量一点点的增加是雷豪最快乐的事，现在，他练力用的巨石已经超过四千斤，想想就是一个很恐怖的数字。他的身材又高大了一圈，全身肌肉都高高的隆起，充满了爆发力。这牛妖身就是强悍，练到如今他都没遇到过瓶颈，每天力量都在增长。当然，这也和雷豪的玩命锻炼有关系，每当他感受到背上巨石的压力小了他就毫不犹豫的换更重的，好在坎源山够大，手下小妖也都熟悉，才能每每找到合适的巨石。多少次他都把自己练得昏死了过去，如果不是每天他身旁都有两牛妖照看，可能早就被身上的巨石砸死，当然，如果是前世这么练，也肯定是早就废了，人的身体有极限，妖身却没有。

而新生的小妖在一段时间之内自身的力量都会出现一个大幅度的上升，而雷豪紧紧的抓住了这个时间，把他的身体打熬得无比的结实。

雷豪偷偷的用过洞府中另一位大统领象统领的兵器，一件一千多斤重的狼牙棒，试了试，能用，但想要运用自如显然还不行，这让雷豪看到了差距，下定决心更加努力的去打熬。

在月圆之夜的时候雷豪还试过去吸收月华，但是在月光下盘膝坐了一晚上，收获却微乎其微。他是被混世魔王用启蒙术强迫化形的，现在很难留住灵气，如果没有一门吸收灵气吸收月华的吐纳之术，他的发展空间将会很小，雷豪向豹二十打听过，升到小统领的时候大王就会赏赐一本妖魔决，这让雷豪很是期待。现在的雷豪打熬身体正处于一个快速上升的趋势，到也不是急需，而且他还能从血食中汲取一些气血之力，对于苦于没有吐纳之术的雷豪也是大有好处的。

这天晚上，雷豪带着手下的小妖刚回洞府，就看见了豹二十，雷豪正准备走上去参见，怎么说他毕竟都还算是豹二十手下的一名小队长。

“牛兄弟，你回来了，我还正准备去寻你呢。”豹二十看见了雷豪上前一把抓住雷豪。

“豹统领，有什么事么？”雷豪看了一眼豹二十的脸色，好奇的问道。

“今天我给大王送血食的时候你猜我听到了什么？”豹二十把雷豪拖到洞内的一个角落里故作神秘的说道。

“什么？”雷豪也好奇的问，“大王准备过两天大举攻打蛇妖洞哩。”豹二十左右看了看对雷豪小声的说道。“什么,……”雷豪一惊，差点惊叫出来，亏得豹二十手快捂住了雷豪的嘴。“切莫声张，切莫声张，要是让大王知道我在外面乱传消息，可是要挨鞭子的。”雷豪一惊一乍的吓坏了豹二十。

听到这个消息的雷豪心中一突，有些心慌，虽说经过这两个月的打熬，雷豪的力量和速度都大有长进，可突然听到马上就要开战，他也将要参与厮杀，此时也淡定不了。“大王怎么突然想起来要攻打蛇妖洞？”雷豪压低了声音问豹二十道。

“什么叫突然想起来，我们水脏洞和蛇妖洞有大仇，上一次蛇妖洞攻打咱们水脏洞杀了咱们水脏洞几乎一半的弟兄，就这样大王才又招一批小妖，这个仇大王可一直忍着，加上有了你们这批小妖，咱们水脏洞的妖军恢复了元气大王那还能忍得住？”豹二十看了一眼雷豪答道。

“蛇妖洞很强么？”想了想，雷豪还是决定了解一下敌情。

“肯定是比咱们水脏洞强，咱们大王打不过青蛇王，说是攻打也不过是大王为了找回之前的面子，不然咱水脏洞的脸面往哪放，这周围的从多妖洞可都得笑话咱们。牛兄弟，你是我手下仅有的两个小队长之一，今天特地等你回来给你说这个消息，就想让你多准备准备，你们新妖大多数都是死在第一次战场上，到时候开战了打不过就让你手下那些废物冲上去，留得青山在不愁没柴烧啊，只要你能活下来小妖以后还会有的。”豹二十说完拍了拍雷豪的肩膀转身走了，显然他和雷豪的交情也能值得这么几句。

战争啊，还是妖族之间的战争，雷豪突然就觉得死亡离自己这么近。

=============================分隔线=============================

坎源山的操练场，雷豪看着面前站得整整齐齐的一众小妖，眼神有些飘忽。

和他们朝夕相处了两个多月，雷豪心底开始慢慢接受了这群憨厚的小妖。和前世遇见的那些大多虚伪的朋友相比，这群笨笨的小妖更真诚，更是真心的尊敬雷豪。在外巡山遇见什么他们认为是好东西的都拿回来献宝一样的给雷豪，虽然大多数都是没用的垃圾的野果子和一些没什么灵气的野花野草。上次雷豪为了一己之私跟他们说让他们看到了人参就给雷豪采回来，这群笨笨的小妖真的看见了就采，不管人参是生长在悬崖峭壁上还是山谷底，好几次摔得满身是伤却还一脸傻乎乎的把人参献给雷豪，雷豪的力量能提升得这么快，那些天才地宝功不可没。

这一切都让饱尝人情冷暖的雷豪深深的感动。虽然雷豪从来都没开口说过什么，只是操练得越来越狠了，这50个小妖的实力也都跟着越来越高，如今连小狐狸都能短暂的举起一千多斤重的巨石。

让他们去送死保护自己？雷豪从来就没那么想过，他的血还没那么冰冷。可是攻打蛇妖洞那可是战争，雷豪自己都得想尽办法活下来哪有能力去让这50个小妖都活下来。雷豪不是没想过逃跑，可是这坎源山对雷豪来说很大，可对于混世魔王那个级数的妖怪也就几分钟就能跑个遍，要逃跑被抓回来到时候可就是生死两难了，虽然对于混世魔王那个级数妖怪不太可能管他雷豪一个小妖会不会逃跑，可雷豪不能冒险。

“该死的，该怎么办呢？”雷豪心底不停的嘀咕。

“头，您今天怎么了？”随着时间的推移越来越聪明的一众小妖也发现今天雷豪的不正常，以往头可不会看他们站了都快半个小时还一言不发。

雷豪收回心神看到了面前一个个笨得连关心都全部挂在脸上的小妖，眼睛慢慢的湿润了，他第一次在这个陌生的世界找到了存在感，他要什么都不管就这些没上过战场的小妖能活一半下来就算庆幸，虽然即使他带着这群小妖上战场也不一定就能多活下来几个，但起码他雷豪尽力了，他做了。

“去你妈的，不冲动能叫年轻人？男人，要么死要么活，哪来那么多的磨磨唧唧。”雷豪咬着牙心里吼道。

“弟兄们，今天我们练点别的。”雷豪举了举手里的狼牙棒，这是他作为小队长的武器，以前一直都觉得有时间，还可以先练力量再练习武器，哪知道这么快就要上战场。

“头，为什么今天要练兵器呀？”一个壮实的猩猩妖好奇的问道。

“要你练你就练，哪来那么多的废话。拿起你们的兵器，给我练习。”雷豪大声的呵斥。

而雷豪需要想出一个合适的战阵保护自己和这五十个小兵。

虽然他其实也根本就不会什么战阵，但是他从洞中那些小妖松散的样子看来，妖族的战争应该不会有什么排列布阵，应该是和群殴一样的一拥而上，靠人数和单体战斗力取胜，即使有抱团的，应该也就少数的妖，能超过一队妖的很少。双方也就七八千妖，不会太密集。

他只要牢牢的控制住他手下的五十个小妖，不要被蛇妖洞的第一波攻击冲散就应该能活下来，五十个小妖集中攻击有多少妖能抗的住？大统领级别以下应该是没有。

小妖们手中的兵器五花八棒，刀枪剑棍狼牙棒……首先他们练习的就是在一个固定的阵形把武器向假想的敌人挥去而不要伤到身旁的战友。

雷豪双手揉着太阳穴正在回忆脑海中有限的关于军事的资料。“阵形？唔，好像真没看过关于这方面的书。最出名的36计？唔，记得最清楚的就是脚底抹油跑为上计……坑爹了，早知道就不看X片了，多看点CCTV7的军事节目啊！”

“虎八十七，你个虎日的，把你的刀向外，不要伤到自己兄弟。”雷蒙看着虎八十七的刀差点就砍着他前方的牛九十二了，开口大声的呵斥。

“武器向外？对，有个，那个是叫一字长蛇阵还是叫什么三角阵的，应该就能应付了吧。”雷蒙突然就想到这个战阵。三角状的战阵，具有强大的战场穿凿能力，只要三角尖能承受住压力，速度够快很快就能穿凿蛇妖军，穿凿之后就算是挺住了第一波的进攻。

“弟兄们，都停下，我要告诉你们一个消息，我们水脏洞很快就要和蛇妖洞开战了，我们马上就会上战场。”雷豪说完一众小妖立马吵了起来，虎妖，狮妖，狼妖一个个都很兴奋，这些家伙天生就比较嗜血，雷豪要不是在他们刚被启蒙就打服了他们现在根本就约束不了这些妖。几个牛妖的脸上还算平静，但像小狐狸和鼠妖，猪妖等等都是一脸的害怕。

把一干小妖的神情都看在眼里的雷豪突然一声大喝：“弟兄们，你们相信我么？”

“好，你们就跟着我，我带你们活着上战场，也带你活着回来。你们，愿意跟着我么？”雷豪一句一顿的说道。

众妖沉默了片刻，然后声嘶力竭的喊道：“我们誓死跟着头。”连一向害羞的小狐狸也涨红了脸。他们是小妖，他们是笨，可他们不是傻，经过两个多月的相处，这些当初懵懵懂懂的小妖早就已经明白谁待他们好，谁待他们不好。而每天受雷豪的影响他们的思维也更靠近雷豪的思考方式，雷豪重情义，他们也一样。

巨大的声音回荡在坎源山里，惊起了一群飞鸟，仿佛是这一刻的见证者。;
content_en:
Two months passed in a flash. Lei Hao got up every morning at midnight, practiced all morning, and took his team out to patrol the mountains at noon. He worked on his body and strength, and his little demons patrolled the mountains. In the evening, he trained his little demons again. This kind of life was simple and fulfilling.

It turns out that he, Lei Hao, can live such a fulfilling life without his computer, his mobile phone, and his tablet.

Lei Hao's happiest thing is to feel his strength increase little by little every day. Now, the boulder he uses for strength training has exceeded 4,000 kilograms, which is a very scary number when you think about it.His figure had grown taller again, and the muscles all over his body were bulging, full of explosive power.This bull demon is physically strong. He has never encountered a bottleneck in his training until now, and his strength is growing every day.Of course, this is also related to Lei Hao's life-threatening training. Whenever he feels that the pressure of the boulder on his back is reduced, he will change to a heavier one without hesitation. Fortunately, Kanyuan Mountain is big enough and the little demons under him are familiar with it, so they can always find the right boulder.He had trained himself so many times that he passed out. If he hadn't been watched over by two bull demons every day, he might have been crushed to death by a huge boulder. Of course, if he had practiced like this in his previous life, he would have been disabled long ago. The human body has limits, but the demon body does not.

The newly born little demon's strength will increase significantly within a period of time, and Lei Hao seizes this time tightly and beats his body to become extremely strong.

Lei Hao secretly used the weapon of Commander Xiang, another commander in the cave, a mace weighing more than a thousand kilograms. He tried it and it worked, but it was obviously not enough to use it freely. This made Lei Hao see the gap and determined to work harder.

On a full moon night, Lei Hao tried to absorb the moonlight, but after sitting cross-legged under the moonlight for a whole night, his gains were minimal.He was forced into shape by the Enlightenment Technique by the Demon King. Now it is difficult to retain his spiritual energy. Without a breathing technique that can absorb spiritual energy and moonlight, his development space will be very small. Lei Hao asked Leopard 20 that when he was promoted to the rank of junior commander, the king would reward him with a book of Demon Art, which made Lei Hao look forward to it.Now Lei Hao's body is on a rapid upward trend, so there is no urgent need. Moreover, he can also draw some energy and blood from the blood food, which is also of great benefit to Lei Hao who suffers from the lack of breathing skills.

That night, Lei Hao and his little demons had just returned to the cave when they saw Leopard Twenty. Lei Hao was about to go up to see him. After all, he was still a squad leader under Leopard Twenty.

"Brother Niu, you're back. I'm about to go look for you." Leopard Twenty saw Lei Hao and stepped forward to grab Lei Hao.

"Commander Leopard, what's the matter?" Lei Hao glanced at Leopard Twenty's face and asked curiously.

"What do you think I heard when I delivered blood food to the king today?" Leopard Twenty dragged Lei Hao to a corner of the cave and said pretending to be mysterious.

"What?" Lei Hao also asked curiously, "Your Majesty is preparing to attack the Snake Demon Cave in two days." Leopard Twenty looked around and whispered to Lei Hao."What..." Lei Hao was startled and almost screamed, but Leopard Twenty quickly covered Lei Hao's mouth with his hands."Don't make any noise, don't make any noise. If the king knows that I am spreading news outside, I will be whipped." Lei Hao frightened Leopard Twenty.

When Lei Hao heard the news, he felt a little flustered. Although after two months of hard work, Lei Hao's strength and speed had greatly improved, but he suddenly heard that a war was about to start and he was about to participate in the fight. He couldn't calm down at this time."Why did the king suddenly think of attacking the Snake Demon Cave?" Lei Hao lowered his voice and asked Leopard Twenty.

"What do you mean, I suddenly remembered that our Shuizang Cave and the Snake Demon Cave have a big feud. The last time the Snake Demon Cave attacked our Shuizang Cave, they killed almost half of our Shuizang Cave brothers. Just like that, the king recruited another group of little demons. This Qiu King has been able to endure it. With your group of little demons, our demon army in the Shuizang Cave has regained its vitality. How can the king endure it?" Leopard Twenty glanced at Lei Hao and asked.

"Is the Snake Demon Cave strong?" After thinking about it, Lei Hao decided to find out more about the enemy.

"It must be better than our Shuizangdong. Our king can't defeat the Green Snake King. The attack is just for the king to regain his previous face. Otherwise, where can we put Shuizhangdong's face? The surrounding demon caves will laugh at us. Brother Niu, you are one of the only two team captains under my command. I am waiting for you to come back today to tell you the news. I just want to let you know.You should be more prepared. Most of your new demons will die on the first battlefield. When the war starts, if you can't fight, let your losers rush forward and leave the green hills without worrying about firewood.As long as you can survive, there will be more demons in the future." Leopard Twenty patted Lei Hao on the shoulder and turned away. Obviously, his friendship with Lei Hao was worthy of such a few words.

War, or a war between demon clans, Lei Hao suddenly felt that death was so close to him.

=============================Divider================================

At the training ground of Kanyuan Mountain, Lei Hao looked at the little demons standing neatly in front of him, his eyes a little wandering.

After spending more than two months with them day and night, Lei Hao began to slowly accept these honest little monsters in his heart.Compared with the mostly hypocritical friends I met in my previous life, these stupid little demons are more sincere and truly respect Lei Hao.Whatever they encountered in the Outer Patrol Mountains that they thought was good, they brought it back and presented it to Lei Hao as if it were a treasure, although most of them were useless garbage, wild fruits and some uninspired wild flowers and weeds.Last time, Lei Hao told them to pick ginseng for Lei Hao for his own benefit. These stupid little monsters really picked it when they saw it, no matter whether the ginseng grew on the cliff or at the bottom of the valley. They fell and were injured several times but still presented the ginseng to Lei Hao with a stupid look on their face. Lei Hao's power can increase so quickly, and those genius treasures are indispensable.

All this deeply moved Lei Hao, who had experienced the warmth and coldness of human relationships.Although Lei Hao never said anything, he just practiced harder and harder, and the strength of these 50 little demons also increased. Now, even the little fox can briefly lift a boulder weighing more than a thousand kilograms.

Let them risk their lives to protect themselves?Lei Hao had never thought about it that way, and his blood was not that cold yet.But attacking the snake demon cave is a war. Lei Hao himself has to try his best to survive, but he has no ability to let these 50 little demons survive.It's not that Lei Hao has never thought about escaping, but Kanyuan Mountain is very big for Lei Hao, but a monster of the level of the Demon King can run all over it in just a few minutes. If he wants to escape and is caught, it will be a dilemma of life and death. Although it is impossible for a monster of the level of the Demon King to care whether Lei Hao, a little monster, will escape, Lei Hao cannot take risks.

"Damn it, what should I do?" Lei Hao kept muttering in his heart.

"Tou, what's wrong with you today?" As time went by, the little demons became smarter and smarter and discovered that Lei Hao was not normal today. In the past, Tou would not look at them and they stood there without saying a word for almost half an hour.

Lei Hao withdrew his mind and saw the little monsters in front of him who were so stupid that they even showed concern on their faces. His eyes slowly became moist. For the first time, he found a sense of existence in this strange world. He didn't care about anything. It would be lucky if these little monsters who had never been on the battlefield could survive half of them. Although he might not be able to survive a few more even if he took these little monsters to the battlefield, at least Lei Hao tried his best. He did it.

"Fuck you, how can you be called a young man if you are not impulsive? Man, you have to live or die, how can there be so much grinding and grinding." Lei Hao gritted his teeth and roared in his heart.

"Brothers, let's practice something else today." Lei Hao raised the mace in his hand. This was his weapon as the squad leader. He had always thought that if he had time, he could practice strength first and then practice weapons. Who knew he would be on the battlefield so soon.

"Boss, why are you practicing weapons today?" A sturdy orangutan demon asked curiously.

"Practice if you want. How can there be so much nonsense? Pick up your weapons and practice for me." Lei Hao scolded loudly.

And Lei Hao needed to come up with a suitable battle formation to protect himself and these fifty soldiers.

Although he actually doesn't know any battle formations at all, but judging from the loose appearance of the little monsters in the cave, the monster clan's war should not have any formations. It should be a swarm like a group fight, relying on the number of people and individual combat power to win. Even if there is a group, there should be only a few monsters, and very few can surpass a group of monsters.There are only seven or eight thousand demons on both sides, so they won't be too dense.

As long as he can firmly control the fifty little demons under him and not be scattered by the first wave of attacks from the Snake Demon Cave, he should be able to survive. How many demons can resist the concentrated attack of fifty little demons?There should be none below the level of general commander.

The weapons in the hands of the little monsters are all kinds of weapons, including swords, guns, swords, sticks and maces... First of all, what they practice is to swing the weapons at the imaginary enemy in a fixed formation without hurting the comrades beside them.

Lei Hao rubbed his temples with both hands and was recalling the limited military information in his mind."Formation? Hmm, I don't think I've ever read a book about this. The most famous 36 tactics? Hmm, the one I remember most clearly is the trick of rubbing oil on the soles of your feet and running away... It's a scam. If I had known better, I wouldn't have watched X-movies. Watch more military programs on CCTV7!"

"Hu 87, you tiger-sun, point your knife outward, don't hurt your brother." Raymond looked at Hu 87's knife and almost cut Niu 92 in front of him, and he yelled loudly.

"Weapons facing outwards? Yes, there is one. Is it called a long snake formation or a triangle formation? It should be able to handle it." Raymond suddenly thought of this battle formation.The triangular battle formation has a strong ability to penetrate the battlefield. As long as the triangle tip can withstand the pressure and is fast enough, it can penetrate the snake demon army quickly. After the penetration, it will be considered as withstanding the first wave of attacks.

"Brothers, stop. I want to tell you a news. Our Shuizang Cave will soon start a war with the Snake Demon Cave. We will go to the battlefield soon." After Lei Hao said that, the little demons immediately started arguing. The tiger demon, lion demon, and wolf demon were all very excited. These guys are naturally more bloodthirsty. If Lei Hao hadn't conquered them when they were just enlightened, he wouldn't be able to restrain these demons at all.The faces of the several bull demons were relatively calm, but the little fox, rat demon, pig demon, etc. all looked scared.

Lei Hao, who saw the expressions of all the little demons, suddenly shouted: "Brothers, do you believe me?"

"Okay, just follow me. I will take you to the battlefield alive and bring you back alive. Are you willing to follow me?" Lei Hao said one after another.

The demons were silent for a moment, and then shouted at the top of their lungs: "We will follow you to the death." Even the shy little fox blushed.They are little demons, they are stupid, but they are not stupid. After more than two months of getting along with each other, these initially ignorant little demons have already understood who treats them well and who treats them badly.And under the influence of Lei Hao every day, their thinking is closer to Lei Hao's way of thinking. Lei Hao values ​​friendship, and so do they.

The huge sound echoed in Kanyuan Mountain, startling a flock of birds, as if they were witnesses of this moment.;
